artworks.title: The Shipwreck
artworks.description: Aivazovsky's storm — the false beacon on Caphareus that lured the victors onto the Capherian rocks, Nauplius' answer when justice for Palamedes was denied at the ships.

artworks.title: Ulysses and Telemachus
artworks.description: Bottani's father and son — the infant snatched from Penelope's arms when Palamedes exposed Odysseus' feigned madness, the grudge that led to the forged letter and the stoning.

artworks.title: Clytemnestra
artworks.description: Collier's Clytemnestra with the axe — one of the houses Nauplius poisoned from afar when he turned the Greek wives against their returning husbands.
